_description: MIKA AGENTIC OS — Video Router provider profiles. All providers are STAGED. No API connections or video generation will occur. This file defines prompt formatting requirements and routing logic for when providers are activated.
_governance: All video generation requires human approval. No provider may be called autonomously.

providers.bestFor: Luxury founder content, premium brand storytelling, cinematic quality
strengths: Highest visual quality of commercial providers
Excellent camera motion and cinematic framing
Great for luxury and premium brand positioning
Handles complex lighting and atmosphere well
limitations: Higher cost per generation
Slower generation times
Less suited for fast-turnaround social content
providers.promptGuidance: Use rich, detailed scene descriptions. Include camera movement, lighting quality, atmospheric details, and emotional tone. Longer prompts (3-5 sentences) perform better. Include negative prompt to exclude unwanted elements.

promptStructure.example: A confident female entrepreneur sits in a minimalist studio, golden hour light streaming through floor-to-ceiling windows. Camera slowly pushes in from wide to medium close-up. Warm, aspirational atmosphere. Luxury tech aesthetic — clean, premium, focused. --negative ugly, distorted, low quality

providers.bestFor: AI Twin content, avatar-based talking head videos, scripted explainers
strengths: Best-in-class AI avatar quality
Excellent lip sync and natural expression
Supports custom avatar creation from photos
Fast generation for scripted content
limitations: Limited to talking-head and presenter formats
Less suited for cinematic or abstract content
Avatar variety limited to pre-built or custom uploads
providers.promptGuidance: Structure as: Avatar Selection, Background, Script, Voice, and Style settings. The 'prompt' is primarily the script the avatar will deliver. Background can be custom image/video or preset. Keep script clear and natural-sounding.

promptStructure.example:
Avatar: [Custom Avatar — Mika]
Background: [AI studio background — dark minimalist]
Script: 'I 10x\'d my content output in 3 days. No team, no agency. Here\'s exactly how I did it.'
Voice: [ElevenLabs — Confident Female]
Captions: Enabled
Resolution: 1080x1920 (vertical)

providers.bestFor: Creative brand assets, thumbnails, carousels, animated stills, B-roll imagery
strengths: Excellent creative and artistic control
Wide model selection (SDXL, Flux, etc.)
Strong for brand assets and thumbnails
Good price-to-quality ratio
ControlNet support for precise composition
limitations: Less suited for realistic video/motion
Shorter video durations
Motion quality less refined than dedicated video providers
providers.promptGuidance: Use Stable Diffusion / Flux prompt syntax. Include style keywords, quality boosters, and negative prompts. Supports ControlNet for reference images. Use :: weight syntax for emphasis. Keep prompts 50-150 words.

promptStructure.example:
Confident female creator in minimalist studio, golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, professional headshot, luxury aesthetic, 8k resolution, photorealistic, cinematic color grade
--negative ugly, deformed, blurry, amateur, busy background
Model: Flux 1.1 Pro | AR: 9:16 | Steps: 30

providers.bestFor: Cinematic storytelling, narrative content, coherent long-form scenes
strengths: Best narrative coherence across all providers
Excellent subject and motion consistency across frames
Strong for storytelling and branded content
Good at following complex scene descriptions
limitations: Premium cost
Access currently limited via Google Vertex AI
Less suited for fast-turnaround short-form social
providers.promptGuidance: Write as a director's shot description. Include: Subject description, setting, action, camera movement, duration (4s or 8s), aspect ratio, mood. Veo responds well to clear action and motion descriptions.

promptStructure.example: A female entrepreneur walks confidently through a glass-walled office at golden hour. Camera tracks alongside her at shoulder height, smooth dolly movement. She pauses, looks directly at camera with a knowing smile. Duration: 8s. Aspect: 16:9. Mood: confident, aspirational, premium.

providers.bestFor: Fast social video, TikTok/Reels, UGC-style content, quick product demos
strengths: Fast generation speed
Optimised for short-form social formats
Good image-to-video consistency
Cost-effective for high-volume content
TikTok/Instagram Reels aspect ratios native
limitations: Lower cinematic quality than Higgsfield/Veo
Less detailed atmospheric control
Better suited for 5-10 second clips
providers.promptGuidance: Keep prompts concise and action-focused (1-2 sentences). Lead with the subject and primary action. Include aspect ratio and duration. Kling responds better to direct, clear descriptions than poetic/atmospheric ones.

promptStructure.example: Female creator talking directly to camera in modern studio, gesturing confidently, natural lighting. Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds.

providers.bestFor: Open-source generation, zero API cost, local execution, experimental workflows
strengths: No API cost — runs locally or on own infrastructure
Full control over generation parameters
Good for experimental and non-commercial content
Open weights — can be fine-tuned
Active community and LoRA support
limitations: Requires local GPU (VRAM 12GB+) or hosted setup
Lower quality ceiling than commercial providers
Slower without dedicated hardware
Less consistent for brand-critical content
providers.promptGuidance: Use Wan-style prompts: positive prompt, negative prompt, and optional motion score. Include subject, environment, lighting, and quality descriptors. Add 'masterpiece, best quality, high resolution' for quality boosting. Use negative prompt to control artifacts.

promptStructure.example:
Masterpiece, best quality, high resolution. Confident woman at desk in modern office, natural window lighting, shallow depth of field, professional look, smooth motion.
--negative low quality, artifacts, distorted face, jerky motion, blurry
Motion Score: 4 | 720p | 16fps

providers.bestFor: Advanced local workflows, custom node pipelines, maximum control over generation
strengths: Maximum workflow control via node graph
Supports every open-source model and LoRA
Can chain complex generation steps
No API cost — fully local
Hugely customisable for brand-specific outputs
limitations: Requires technical setup (GPU, node configuration)
Higher complexity — not suitable for quick iterations
Workflow design requires ComfyUI expertise
Primarily for power users
providers.promptGuidance: Define as a workflow brief: specify the node chain (model → sampling → upscaling), checkpoint, LoRA models, VAE, and sampler settings. The 'prompt' describes both the visual content AND the workflow configuration.

promptStructure.example:
Checkpoint: RealVisXL v5.0
LoRA: [brand-aesthetic v1.2 strength: 0.8]
Positive: Confident woman at minimal desk, cinematic lighting, shallow DOF, editorial quality
Negative: ugly, deformed, watermark, low quality
Sampler: DPM++ 2M Karras | Steps: 30 | CFG: 7
Upscale: 4x UltraSharp

providers.bestFor: Cinematic product showcases, B-roll packages, lifestyle brand content
strengths: Purpose-built for product and brand B-roll
High visual fidelity for physical product shots
Prompt pack native — reads video-prompt-pack.json directly
Excellent for lifestyle and aspirational brand content
limitations: Not suited for talking-head or avatar content
Less flexible for abstract or experimental styles
Requires detailed visual prompt packs for best results
providers.promptGuidance: Structure prompts around the product or scene as subject. Specify surface, lighting rig, camera angle, motion speed, and background. Reference brand colour palette for consistency. Use the visual_prompting stage output from the viral workflow as the primary input.

promptStructure.example: Luxury skincare serum bottle on a dark slate surface. Soft side-lighting with warm gold highlights. Camera arcs slowly left to right at eye level. Background: deep obsidian bokeh. Color palette: gold and black. Mood: premium, confident, editorial.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Best price-to-quality ratio with commercial providers
